measure.default_unit: base UoM quantity and material-plant line count (SKU)
measure.policy: QTY is the headline everywhere. INR appears only when the Qty/Value toggle is set to Value. Plan vs Actual is the single exception and says so: the source table has no quantity column.

contextflow.forecast_status: DEGRADED - no forward horizons, no material grain

filters.cascade_note: Plant -> Material Type -> Material Group is backed by the group_type and plant_mc aggregates. The Material level resolves stock, ROP, safety stock and the PR recommendation from the engine detail, but NOT a forecast quantity - see the demand_forecast material_level_forecast block.

kpis.label: Gross inventory reduction
kpis.note: Measured on value because gross inventory is a value KPI by definition; the QTY equivalent cannot be trended — FACT_INVENTORY_SNAPSHOT closing qty reconciles only at the 2025-12-31 as-of date, not as a 24-month series.

kpis.label: Slow-moving inventory reduction (SMI)
kpis.note: The slow-moving series is volatile month to month (160m to 1,352m INR inside 2025); a first-vs-last reading is sensitive to the endpoint and is shown with the full series.

kpis.label: Quantity forecast accuracy (1 - WAPE)
kpis.note: The published WAPE belongs to WeightedEnsemble_L2 (rank 2, rmse 174.086569), not to the deployed champion ExtraTreesMSE (rmse 172.503385) — the diagnostics block's rmse/r2 match rank 2 exactly. The holdout is also a deterministic RANDOM 20% split, not the time-ordered 6-month split the brief requires, so this figure is an optimistic upper bound on forecast accuracy rather than forecast accuracy.
kpis.mape_uncomputable_reason: The target contains zero-demand cohort-months, so MAPE diverges; every candidate's own MAPE is of order 1e15. Use WAPE.

kpis.label: Inventory forecast accuracy
kpis.basis: would require a forecast of closing inventory position compared against actuals
kpis.uncomputable_reason: No inventory-position forecast exists. ContextFlow experiment 6ae894a219423a530ab79f69 forecasts consumption quantity (target actual_qty), not inventory position, and step2_forecast.json was never produced (S-3 blocked). Missing field: a forecast of FACT_INVENTORY_SNAPSHOT.CLOSING_QTY per material-plant-month.

kpis.note: Coverage is 100% of lines. Agreement with SAP's own REORDER_POINT_QTY is a separate measure and is far lower: 7791 of 34717 lines (22.44%) sit within the +/-20% flag band.

kpis.label: Duplicate SKU clusters identified

reconciliation.policy: CURATED / RAW / Diff / Diff% shown for every item; nothing suppressed.

items.item: Gross inventory QTY (base UoM), 6 physical plants
Gross inventory VALUE INR (Value toggle), 6 physical plants
items.note: INVENTORY_KPI_MONTHLY also carries a PLANT_ID='ALL_PLANTS' row of 5,125,222,947 INR which equals the sum of the six plants exactly. It is a rollup, not a seventh plant — summing all seven PLANT_ID values double-counts to 10.25 bn.

items.curated_source: none — no curated movement table exists in VEDANTA_POC
items.note: Reported as RAW baseline; there is no curated counterpart to differ from.

items.raw_source: recomputed from last MovType-261 date per material-plant using the brief's thresholds
items.root_cause: The curated table classifies 1,195 lines as OBSOLETE whose own DAYS_SINCE_LAST_CONSUMPTION is in the 181-365 bucket — i.e. NON_MOVING under the brief's rule. The curated age column itself agrees with RAW on 100% of those 1,195 lines (DSLC_MATCHES_RAW = 1,195/1,195), so the ageing is identical and only the NM/OBS cut-point differs: the curated rule applies a threshold below 365 days. A further 4 lines are classified OBSOLETE with no 261 movement ever; the brief's rule makes never-issued = NON_MOVING. 1,195 + 4 = 1,199.
items.impact: ACTIVE and SLOW_MOVING are unaffected, so the SMI KPI is safe. NMI and the Obsolete KPI shift materially depending on which rule is used.
items.resolution: Dashboard must compute NM/SM/OBS from the brief's rule (RAW) and display the CURATED figure alongside it with this warning. Neither value is altered in HANA.
items.diff_basis: lines reclassified between classes, as a percentage of all 34717 in-scope lines

items.raw_source: trailing-12m net demand / 365 x DIM_MATERIAL.PLANNED_DELIVERY_DAYS + curated SAFETY_STOCK_QTY
items.status: DIFFERENCE — within tolerance in aggregate, not line by line
items.root_cause: Two drivers. (a) Lead time: the RAW recomputation uses PLANNED_DELIVERY_DAYS only, while the brief's rule is MAX(planned, actual) + median PR-to-PO — so the RAW ROP here is a lower bound and the true figure will move once actual lead time and PR-to-PO latency are joined in. (b) Demand basis: curated TRAILING_12M_DEMAND_QTY matches ISSUES-ONLY (261) on 25,925 of 34,717 lines but NET (261-262) on only 18,927 — the curated trailing demand is closer to a gross-issues measure than to the brief's net definition. Curated T12 sum 2,091,095.4 vs RAW net 1,770,896.3 (diff -320,199.1, -15.3%) vs RAW issues-only 1,815,618.3 (diff -275,477.1, -13.2%). Neither matches exactly, so a third adjustment (likely a different 12-month window or a backcast inclusion) is also present.
items.resolution: The dashboard's ROP must be recomputed from RAW once actual lead time and median PR-to-PO are available (step 2); the +/-20% ROP flag is driven off that recomputation. Curated ROP is shown as the SAP-master comparison column.

items.item: Reorder point total (engine vs curated REORDER_RECOMMENDATION)
items.raw_source: engine ROP = lead-time demand + safety stock over 34,717 lines
items.note: The curated table covers 3,916 material-plant pairs; the engine covers all 34,717 in-scope lines. The difference is mostly population, not method, and the two are never netted. Shown because the brief says never hide a difference.

items.item: Movement-class counts (engine rule vs curated MOVEMENT_CLASS)
items.note: 1,195 lines aged 181-365 days are curated OBSOLETE but are NON_MOVING under the brief; 4 never-issued lines are curated OBSOLETE but are NON_MOVING under the brief. ACTIVE and SLOW_MOVING agree exactly. The engine rule governs every figure here.

reconciliation.note: CURATED / RAW / Diff / Diff% for every item. Where the two disagree the engine rule from the brief governs, and the curated figure is still shown.

warnings.message: step2_forecast.json does not exist in the workspace or on the remote. S-3 is blocked. The ContextFlow model evidence file is used instead, so model identity and holdout accuracy are available but forward horizon quantities are not.

The deployed ContextFlow model cannot project forward: a predict for 2099-06 returns exactly 2026-06's value (1397.11669921875). Forward horizons 3/6/9/12 are published as UNCOMPUTABLE rather than as a replay of history.

MATERIAL_ID is not a ContextFlow feature. MAT-000001 and MAT-005999 return byte-identical predictions, so no material-level forecast is published. The brief's drill-to-material SUCCESS criterion is not met by this experiment.
ContextFlow used a deterministic RANDOM 20% holdout, not the time-ordered 6-month holdout the brief requires. Reported accuracy is an optimistic upper bound, not forecast accuracy.
The published WAPE 0.477518 / RMSE 174.086569 belong to WeightedEnsemble_L2 (rank 2), not to the deployed champion ExtraTreesMSE (RMSE 172.503385).
Two ContextFlow endpoints are in_service on the same asset, 35% apart on RMSE. This dashboard pins experiment 6ae894a219423a530ab79f69.

CURATED movement class disagrees with the brief's rule on 1,199 of 34,717 lines (3.45%): 1,195 NM-aged lines are flagged OBSOLETE and 4 never-issued lines are flagged OBSOLETE rather than NON_MOVING. NMI and Obsolete KPIs are affected; ACTIVE and SLOW_MOVING are not.

Curated ROP is 3.64% below a RAW recomputation, and only 16,340 of 34,717 lines agree within +/-20%. Curated trailing-12m demand behaves like gross 261 issues rather than net 261-262. Do not treat curated ROP as the brief's ROP.
PLANT_ID='ALL_PLANTS' exists in DIM_PLANT and INVENTORY_KPI_MONTHLY as a pre-aggregated rollup equal to the sum of the six physical plants. Every plant filter and sum must exclude it.
4 of the 34,717 classified material-plant pairs have no 261 movement at all in or before the period. They are never-issued and must be classed NON_MOVING per the brief.

Material group LUBRICANTS has months with no 261/262 movement at all; its series carries nulls rather than zeros in step1/aggregates/type_group_month.json. Forecasting must treat the gap explicitly, not impute it.

No MRP-type column exists anywhere in VEDANTA_POC. A catalogue scan of SYS.TABLE_COLUMNS over all 42 tables / 377 columns for '%MRP%', '%DISPO%' returned zero hits; the SAP field MARC-DISMM is not in the extract and is absent from SAP_FIELD_MAPPING. The VB/PD split in section 8 is UNCOMPUTABLE.
BUSINESS_PLAN_VS_ACTUAL carries VALUE columns only (PLAN_VALUE_INR / ACTUAL_PO_VALUE_INR / ACTUAL_GR_VALUE_INR). There is no planned-quantity column, so the Qty view of section 10 is UNCOMPUTABLE.

Every one of the 36 events in DIM_SHUTDOWN_EVENT has STATUS='COMPLETED' and PLANNED_START_DATE <= 2025-09-19. There is no future-dated or PLANNED/IN_PROGRESS shutdown anywhere in the table, so projected shutdown requirement is UNCOMPUTABLE from this extract.

RED against target: Non-moving inventory reduction (NMI) (actual -1.398 vs target 10.0); Slow-moving inventory reduction (SMI) (actual -90.3924 vs target 20.0); Quantity forecast accuracy (1 - WAPE) (actual 52.2482 vs target 90.0); NM/SM classification F1 (actual 0.510731 vs target 0.9); PR count YoY change (actual 34.9219 vs target 10.0); Non-Operating-Material days (actual 121.66 vs target 90.0)
UNCOMPUTABLE: Inventory forecast accuracy
Simulated POC figure. Not actual Vedanta or Hindustan Zinc performance and not a claim of realised savings.

holdout.reason: The split is a deterministic RANDOM 20% holdout over a time series, so 2025-12 rows can train while 2024-03 rows test. Reported accuracy is an in-sample-period number, not 6-month-ahead forecast accuracy.

deviation_band.reason: A +/-15% band needs a forward forecast series to sit around; no forward series exists.

last12_vs_next12.reason: No forward 12-month ContextFlow forecast exists (see horizons).
last12_vs_next12.engine_f12_note: The engine's own 12-month figure is trailing-12 net demand carried forward; it drives ROP and MAX arithmetic and is NOT a ContextFlow forecast.

seasonality.source: SEASONALITY_INPUT, 864 rows (6 plants x 12 groups x 12 months), COALESCE(MANUAL_OVERRIDE_INDEX, SEASON_INDEX_DERIVED) averaged by calendar month
seasonality.basis: Avg monthly net consumption value 2024-2025, normalised

accuracy.mape_reason: The target contains zero-demand cohort-months (154 confirmed in HANA), so MAPE diverges; every candidate's own MAPE is of order 1e15. Use WAPE.
accuracy.warning: These diagnostics are computed for WeightedEnsemble_L2 (rmse 174.086569, r2 0.711535), NOT for the rank-1 winner ExtraTreesMSE (rmse 172.503385, r2 0.716757). The diagnostics block's rmse/r2 match rank 2 exactly. Any WAPE quoted for 'the ContextFlow model' is therefore the runner-up's WAPE, not the champion's.

model_selection.why_it_ranked_first_verbatim: ContextFlow ranked candidates on the holdout root_mean_squared_error it was given as primaryMetric. ExtraTreesMSE scored 172.503385, the lowest of the 11 candidates; WeightedEnsemble_L2 was second at 174.086569 and NeuralNetTorch third at 178.123274. The margin over second place is 1.583184 RMSE = 0.91%. No model was chosen by a human; bestCandidateId is what the engine returned.

endpoint.live_check: POST predict returned 200 with numeric predictions on 2026-11-04T18:10:21Z — the endpoint serves.

validated_regression_not_classification.evidence: dataset.problemType = 'regression' and endpoint.problemType = 'regression' on both experiments; probabilities = null and decisionThreshold = null on the live predict response; the diagnostics block is kind='regression' with residuals and r2, not a confusion matrix.

validated_target_is_a_quantity.evidence: targetColumn = 'actual_qty' on the dataset and on the deployed endpoint; the live predict response returns targetColumn 'actual_qty' with continuous values (1290.1533203125, 10.850000381469727). Holdout actuals include 0 and -1, consistent with a net-demand quantity rather than a class label.

validated_model_chosen_by_engine.evidence: bestCandidateId is returned by the engine and matches endpoint.candidateId on both experiments. No champion/approve_champion call was made by this cell.

second_deployed_experiment.name: Demand Regression
second_deployed_experiment.significance: A SECOND experiment is deployed and in_service on the same asset and the same analysisId, trained on the same 6,000-row file but with domainType 'general' and a 3-model curated plan. It is materially worse (RMSE 232.885196 vs 172.503385; WAPE 0.598288 vs 0.477518; r2 0.483766 vs 0.716757). Two in_service endpoints exist. The dashboard must name the experiment id it reads, or it can silently serve the weaker model.

by_driver.note: Driver splits are trailing-12 net demand from HANA, the quantity the engine's ROP and MAX use. They are not ContextFlow forward forecasts.

material_level_forecast.reason: MATERIAL_ID is not a feature of the deployed ContextFlow model. Proven empirically: two predict rows identical except MATERIAL_ID (MAT-000001 vs MAT-005999) both returned 1290.1533203125, byte-identical. The finest grain the model can express is the 2,027-way cohort. A material-level number would be one cohort value repeated across 34,717 lines and would be an allocation, not a forecast.
material_level_forecast.missing_field: MATERIAL_ID as a ContextFlow feature column

lead_time_variability.rule: MAX(PLANNED_DELIVERY_DAYS, median actual PO->GR per material) + median PR->PO

planned_and_projected_requirements.reason: FACT_MAINTENANCE_REQUIREMENT carries exactly one STATUS ('COMPLETED') and one PR_TYPE ('ZMNT'), with no date and no plant column; DIM_SHUTDOWN_EVENT has no event later than 2025-09-19 and every event is COMPLETED. There is no open or future requirement in the extract to project.
planned_and_projected_requirements.missing_field: an open/planned maintenance or shutdown requirement with a future date

inventory_health.title: Inventory Health
inventory_health.description: Stock position at 2025-12-31 in base UoM, split by movement class and plant. INR is the toggle field only.

positions.committed_basis: RESERVED_QTY is 0.000 on every in-scope line at the as-of date. Committed stock is therefore reported as 0, not as UNCOMPUTABLE: the column exists and its value is zero.
positions.recommended_basis: sum of engine MAX = ROP + 3-month forecast across the 34,717 lines
positions.curated_recommended_basis: REORDER_RECOMMENDATION.MAX_STOCK_QTY over its 3,916 rows — a different population from the engine's 34,717 lines, so the two are shown side by side and never netted.

mtd_ytd.qty_reason: INVENTORY_KPI_MONTHLY carries CONSUMPTION_VALUE_INR but no consumption quantity column. The MTD/YTD consumption quantity can be derived from the movement fact and is published in the Demand Forecast history series; it is not available on this curated KPI table.

over_understock.title: Over / Understock
over_understock.description: Lines above max(MAX, 12-month forecast) and lines below ROP, at 2025-12-31. Rule: overstock = stock > max(MAX, 12-month forecast); understock = stock < ROP.

rules_applied.rop: ROP = lead-time demand + safety stock = (net 12m demand / 365) * LT + SS

cards.label: No demand
cards.definition: stock on hand with zero net demand in the trailing 12 months

stockout_risk.definition: Zero stock, or below safety stock, against the criticality service level. VITAL 98% / ESSENTIAL 95% / DESIRABLE 90%.

pr_recommendations.title: PR Recommendations
pr_recommendations.description: What to raise, how much and by when. A line is recommended when stock is below ROP; the quantity closes the gap to MAX after open PRs, rounded to the material MIN_ORDER_QTY and ORDER_MULTIPLE.

rules_applied.quantity: recommended qty = MAX - stock - open PR, rounded up to MIN_ORDER_QTY and ORDER_MULTIPLE
rules_applied.timing: weeks of cover = (stock - safety stock) / weekly demand; bucket 0 = raise now
rules_applied.priority: CRITICAL when stock < safety stock or criticality=VITAL; HIGH on shutdown flag; else MEDIUM

cards.label: Raise immediately

pr_recommendations.recommendations_note: Top 40 below-ROP lines by value-at-risk ((ROP-stock) x unit cost). Lead time here is PLANNED_DELIVERY_DAYS+24 (planned-only variant); the full-rule aggregates are in misc.json.

exceptions.detail: Lines whose SAP REORDER_POINT_QTY sits outside the +/-20% flag band around the engine ROP. Raising to the engine ROP contradicts the material master until the master is corrected.

Lines holding stock with zero net demand in the trailing 12 months. They generate no PR, and they are the first candidates for release.

duplicate_sku.title: Duplicate SKU
duplicate_sku.description: Materials whose description is identical inside one material group. Exact match scores 1.00 and sits in the >=0.80 likely tier; the base-token variant sits in the >=0.60 review tier.
duplicate_sku.method: Deterministic exact match on DIM_MATERIAL.MATERIAL_DESCRIPTION within MATERIAL_GROUP, ZSPR/ZSPN only. pairs.note: Each cluster of N materials implies N-1 redundant materials. Pair-level similarity scores between 0.60 and 1.00 are not produced: no fuzzy or embedding scorer is available in-session, so only the deterministic exact and base-token tiers exist.

raia.title: RAIA - Responsible AI Assessment
raia.description: What the engine is, what it was allowed to conclude, and every place the data would not support a conclusion.

engine.inventory_engine: Deterministic arithmetic over SAP HANA VEDANTA_POC, executed in HANA (step3/sql/engine_base.sql). No model, no imputation, no estimate.

contextflow_model.why_it_won_verbatim: ContextFlow ranked candidates on the holdout root_mean_squared_error it was given as primaryMetric. ExtraTreesMSE scored 172.503385, the lowest of the 11 candidates; WeightedEnsemble_L2 was second at 174.086569 and NeuralNetTorch third at 178.123274. The margin over second place is 1.583184 RMSE = 0.91%. No model was chosen by a human; bestCandidateId is what the engine returned.

validation_regression_not_classification.evidence: dataset.problemType = 'regression' and endpoint.problemType = 'regression' on both experiments; probabilities = null and decisionThreshold = null on the live predict response; the diagnostics block is kind='regression' with residuals and r2, not a confusion matrix.

validation_target_is_quantity.evidence: targetColumn = 'actual_qty' on the dataset and on the deployed endpoint; the live predict response returns targetColumn 'actual_qty' with continuous values (1290.1533203125, 10.850000381469727). Holdout actuals include 0 and -1, consistent with a net-demand quantity rather than a class label.

validation_engine_selected.evidence: bestCandidateId is returned by the engine and matches endpoint.candidateId on both experiments. No champion/approve_champion call was made by this cell.

contextflow_model.second_endpoint_warning: A SECOND experiment is deployed and in_service on the same asset and the same analysisId, trained on the same 6,000-row file but with domainType 'general' and a 3-model curated plan. It is materially worse (RMSE 232.885196 vs 172.503385; WAPE 0.598288 vs 0.477518; r2 0.483766 vs 0.716757). Two in_service endpoints exist. The dashboard must name the experiment id it reads, or it can silently serve the weaker model.

items.raw_source: recomputed from last MovType-261 date per material-plant using the brief's thresholds
items.root_cause: The curated table classifies 1,195 lines as OBSOLETE whose own DAYS_SINCE_LAST_CONSUMPTION is in the 181-365 bucket — i.e. NON_MOVING under the brief's rule. The curated age column itself agrees with RAW on 100% of those 1,195 lines (DSLC_MATCHES_RAW = 1,195/1,195), so the ageing is identical and only the NM/OBS cut-point differs: the curated rule applies a threshold below 365 days. A further 4 lines are classified OBSOLETE with no 261 movement ever; the brief's rule makes never-issued = NON_MOVING. 1,195 + 4 = 1,199.
items.impact: ACTIVE and SLOW_MOVING are unaffected, so the SMI KPI is safe. NMI and the Obsolete KPI shift materially depending on which rule is used.
items.resolution: Dashboard must compute NM/SM/OBS from the brief's rule (RAW) and display the CURATED figure alongside it with this warning. Neither value is altered in HANA.

items.raw_source: trailing-12m net demand / 365 x DIM_MATERIAL.PLANNED_DELIVERY_DAYS + curated SAFETY_STOCK_QTY
items.status: DIFFERENCE — within tolerance in aggregate, not line by line
items.root_cause: Two drivers. (a) Lead time: the RAW recomputation uses PLANNED_DELIVERY_DAYS only, while the brief's rule is MAX(planned, actual) + median PR-to-PO — so the RAW ROP here is a lower bound and the true figure will move once actual lead time and PR-to-PO latency are joined in. (b) Demand basis: curated TRAILING_12M_DEMAND_QTY matches ISSUES-ONLY (261) on 25,925 of 34,717 lines but NET (261-262) on only 18,927 — the curated trailing demand is closer to a gross-issues measure than to the brief's net definition. Curated T12 sum 2,091,095.4 vs RAW net 1,770,896.3 (diff -320,199.1, -15.3%) vs RAW issues-only 1,815,618.3 (diff -275,477.1, -13.2%). Neither matches exactly, so a third adjustment (likely a different 12-month window or a backcast inclusion) is also present.
items.resolution: The dashboard's ROP must be recomputed from RAW once actual lead time and median PR-to-PO are available (step 2); the +/-20% ROP flag is driven off that recomputation. Curated ROP is shown as the SAP-master comparison column.

items.note: The curated table covers 3,916 material-plant pairs; the engine covers all 34,717 in-scope lines. The difference is mostly population, not method, and the two are never netted. Shown because the brief says never hide a difference.

caveats: The published WAPE belongs to WeightedEnsemble_L2 (rank 2), not to the deployed champion ExtraTreesMSE.
The holdout is a deterministic RANDOM 20% split, not the time-ordered 6-month split the brief requires, so the figure is an optimistic upper bound.
MAPE is UNCOMPUTABLE because the target contains zeros.

limitations: No forward forecast: the model replays history rather than projecting it.
No material grain: MATERIAL_ID is not a feature, so the brief's drill-to-material SUCCESS criterion is not met by a forecast, only by an allocation.
Training file is 6,000 rows against 34,717 real material-plant lines.

Every figure is synthetic HZL_DEMO POC data, not Vedanta or Hindustan Zinc performance.
